## Genome Binning

Genome binning groups assembled metagenomic contigs into
potential individual microbial genomes.

For this workshop, I used the instructor-provided MetaBAT2
binning results rather than rerunning the computational analysis.

### Accessing the genome bins

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
cd ~/bbd-metagenome/metabat
ln -s /pvol/data/mg/bbd/metabat/bins_bbd .
```

The symbolic link provides access to the precomputed bins
without duplicating the underlying sequence files.

### Interpretation

The recovered bins represent candidate microbial genomes
from the black band disease-associated community. However,
binning alone does not establish genome completeness,
contamination, or taxonomic identity.

I used the supplied CheckM results to assess bin quality
before proceeding with downstream analyses.
